exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "But, however".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
～けれど
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～けれど.
exercises.explanation: Expresses a soft contrast or contradiction between two statements.
